messages:
anya: Dropped a tiny prototype for tokens: compact chips with a small copy icon and overflow. goal: denser list but avoid accidental copies. attaching gif.

sam: Love density. Q: what's primary action? we should avoid whole-chip copy on Enter.

anya: Plan: chip focus opens details. copy is an inline icon button. reveal uses a modal.

kai: Accessibility: copy button needs aria-label="Copy key to clipboard" and copy should announce "Key copied" only. never expose secret in an aria-live.

design-bot: Also: overflow should have aria-haspopup="true" and menu gets focus on open. Ensure first menu item is keyboard-focusable.

lucy: Revoke wording: change "Revoke" -> "Disable key". Permanently delete moves to advanced settings. Softer tone reduces support tickets.

omar: Rotation flow: ops asked for a cancel window. Suggest: click rotate -> inline status pill "Rotation pending (cancel)" for 8s before showing confirm modal. Avoids accidental bulk rotates.

anya: UX nit: inline pill must be fixed height to avoid pagination jumps. mobile collapses to stacked rows.

kai: SR detail: reveal modal must focus-trap and require explicit "Show secret" click. before revealing, add SR-only text: "Secret will appear on screen."

lucy: Empty state copy: "No API tokens yet. Create a token to start calling Redwood." CTA: "Create token" and secondary "Scopes explained". include hint: press C.

design-bot: Microcopy: bulk revoke conflict modal should list affected tokens and require per-item confirmation. Toasts must not include secret text and should be role=alert with focusable Undo.

anya: Action items: @omar add cancelable pending-rotation placeholder, @kai add SR snippets for copy/reveal, @lucy update copy options, @design-bot output updated comp with copy icon and overflow focus states. I'll iterate tomorrow. :thumbsup:
